summary: Two bedroom mid terrace property offering an excellent investment opportunity with a potential gross yield of approximately 10%.
description:
LIVING ROOM The living room features a large open plan living area with the staircase positioned to the left, creating a bright and versatile space with ample room for both lounge furniture and a dining table. The layout provides a welcoming environment ideal for modern living and entertaining.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units and space for a freestanding oven. There is designated space for a fridge freezer and plumbing in place for a washing machine, providing practicality for everyday living.

BEDROOM One of two double bedrooms located to the rear of the property, housing radiator and double glazed window overlooking the rear aspect.

BEDROOM The largest of the two bedrooms, located to the front of the property. Ample space for a double bed and freestanding furniture.

BATHROOM The bathroom is fitted with a panelled corner bath, low level WC and wash hand basin.

EXTERNALLY Externally the property boasts a rear yard and on street parking. The property is walking distance to local amenities and bus routes.
